body: Fix spec android-macos-e2e-fixes: grounding complete. All nine investigations are in; full detail is in the session scratchpad notes.md and will go into the spec.U+000AU+000ARoot causes per finding (C = confirmed by reading, P = confirmed by probe or widget test, H = hypothesis):U+000AU+002D MB1 (P): Material Slider's always-open OverlayPortal is orphaned from reading order.U+000AU+002D H1 (P): BlockSemantics inside a portal overlay blocks the portal's own anchor.U+000AU+002D MB2 (C, from the system log): scheduling is tied to the Settings screen, reminders are one-shot, refusal is silent. Not signing.U+000AU+002D C7 (C): the row hard-codes HH:mm while the picker follows the system 12/24-hour setting.U+000AU+002D H2 and C1 (C): designed behaviour under composer spec P3, P4 and P6; needs an owner ruling.U+000AU+002D H3 (C): the macOS Edit menu goes to the engine's hidden NSTextView. No paste:, selectAll: or undo: forwarding, and undo state exists on iOS only.U+000AU+002D H4 (C): deleteToEndOfParagraph: is not in Flutter's macOS selector map (framework or editor).U+000AU+002D H5 (C): mouse-down on Cancel unfocuses with scope disposition, so the route has no focus history to restore after Keep editing.U+000AU+002D H6 (C): engine FlutterTextField never sets accessibilityLabel. Still true on upstream master (fetched 2026-09-27). App sub-gap: Search and Caption lose their hint-only name after typing.U+000AU+002D H7 (C): sidebar rail items carry no Semantics. The barriers are Flutter ModalBarrier, which was accepted before.U+000AU+002D H8 (C): recorders have no Escape handler and barrierDismissible is false. Twin: Android back on recorders has no PopScope.U+000AU+002D H9 (C): the base design controls (StickerButton, IconStickerButton, SettingsToggle, SettingsSegmented, SettingsTimeField) are not focusable, and there is no focus token.U+000AU+002D H10 (C): StickerButton has no semantics container, so it folds into the row-sized node.U+000AU+002D H11 (P, mechanism): the editor echoes composing -1 after an empty composing range from the IME. Whether Pinyin sends that is live-only.U+000AU+002D AH1 (C): the toast is positioned on the keyboard only. It fully covers four format buttons and swallows taps for 6 s.U+000AU+002D AH2 (C): no scroll cue; the 48 dp buttons removed an accidental peek.U+000AU+002D AH3 and AC1: Android is probably a phone-tool artefact, since TalkBack walks hit-test order. They are real on macOS, where VoiceOver's pointer hit test uses reading-order frames.U+000AU+002D AC2 (C): slider flag without increase/decrease makes the Android bridge add a click.U+000AU+002D AC3 (C): _ChangeMoodButton has no 48 dp minimum, the bloom label is not excluded, and no sweep state covers it.U+000AU+002D AC4 (C): #209 grew painted boxes rather than hit areas.U+000AU+002D C2, C4, C5 and C8 (C): C8 is also a privacy issue, because temp recordings survive Delete all.U+000AU+002D C3 (C for mechanism): the stopwatch duration differs from the file duration.U+000AU+000ANext: ask the owner the phase 4 decision questions.
